purpose: Before revisiting any incident, match OGE + component + structured code + HTTP; never infer root cause from HTTP alone.

rules.write_back: Link verified result in the original Linear OGE and commit source evidence to this catalog. Never auto-commit from competing CI jobs.

incidents.symptom: MA-OP GitHub read returned 409 because its delegated Yellow read_file capability was unresolved.
incidents.cause: Compatibility mapping for github/read_file was suppressed whenever D1 provider_capabilities contained any other entries.
diagnostic_steps: Read Yellow resolver response for github/read_file; do not interpret the outer MA-OP 409 alone.
Check exact D1 provider_capabilities row: enabled/disabled beats compatibility fallback.
Compare effective_map compatibility selection in worker/capability-resolver-api.ts.
incidents.remedy: Scoped github/read_file compatibility fallback only if no explicit row exists; never revive an explicitly disabled row.
incidents.guardrail: READ only; do not weaken approval or automatically enable unrelated routes.

incidents.symptom: ATHENA promotion tests expected 409 HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED but returned HTTP404 before the approval branch.
incidents.cause: Likely no eligible cloudflare/deploy_promote candidate in real staging resolver; exact missing versus disabled D1 mapping is not yet proved.
diagnostic_steps: Send only a read-only POST /api/capabilities/resolve for provider=cloudflare capability=deploy_promote environment=staging; capture structured status/reason.
Inspect the existing D1 provider_capabilities metadata (READ ONLY) to distinguish missing, disabled and environment/binding mismatches.
Inspect Yellow executor order: unavailable candidate => 404; resolved non-READ descriptor => 409 approval gate.
If staging intentionally disables deploy_promote, assert fail-closed 404 in staging test; don't create a fake active write mapping to satisfy old assertion.
incidents.remedy: Pending evidence; fix the test expectation or verified intended staging mapping ONLY after metadata shows what is wrong.
incidents.guardrail: Do not enable production deploy, write capabilities, or bypass HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED to force HTTP409.

incidents.symptom: OGE-78 check fails at node setup due absent npm lockfile, before the application tests.
incidents.cause: Workflow requests dependency cache that requires a package-lock.json or equivalent, but staging source has no supported lockfile.
diagnostic_steps: Check the failed step, not application runtime first.
Inspect actions/setup-node@v4 cache npm settings and committed lockfile existence.
Prefer disabling cache for this proof or generating a runner-local lockfile; do not introduce conflicting persistent dependency manifests just to green CI.
incidents.remedy: Apply minimal CI-only setup correction and re-run; not yet verified.
incidents.guardrail: Do not claim application bug from a setup failure.

http_hints.interpretation: NO_ROUTE_OR_RESOURCE; inspect exact URL, component, resolver structured status and scope before choosing fix.
CONFLICT_OR_INTENTIONAL_GATE; inspect code and upstream/delegated response. 409 HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED is NOT a bug when expected.
